title: Audit log streaming evidence
description: Self-attested or API-collected configuration record showing that organization-level audit logs are streamed to at least one centralized destination (SIEM, object store, log aggregator). Used by AUDIT-STREAM-060 to close OWASP CICD-SEC-10. Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/audit-log-streaming.json. Trust level: evidence-backed when collection.evidence_collection_method=live; otherwise self-attested.

attested_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the configuration was last verified.

attested_by.description: Username, service principal, or identifier of the attester.

platform.description: Platform whose audit logs are being streamed.

streaming_enabled.description: Whether organization-level audit log streaming is currently enabled.

uri.description: Destination identifier. Redact bucket-internal paths if sensitive.

destinations.description: List of configured streaming destinations. Empty list means streaming is not actually shipping anywhere even if streaming_enabled is true.

retention_days.description: Optional. Retention window applied to the streamed logs at the destination.

events_streamed.description: Optional. Event categories included in the stream (e.g. workflow_run, repo, secret_scanning_alert).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. exceptions, partial coverage, planned migrations).
